foundation: Your look begins with a base that feels like you.
Blend a small amount from the centre of the face outwards. Build gradually where you want more coverage.
Choose your approximate skin tone preference before adding to your bag; confirm the actual manufacturer shade with the store.
powder: A finishing touch to bring your look together.
Apply a little with a brush or puff and blend gently over the areas you want to set.
Use a light hand and choose your preferred skin tone before ordering.
concealer: A little detail that brings your base together.
Dot a small amount where you want coverage, then tap and blend gently. Add more gradually.
Choose the available shade with the store; avoid contact with the eye itself.
mascara: A little lift to your everyday beauty ritual.
Brush gently from the base of your lashes towards the tips. Add a second light coat if desired.
For your own use only. Do not share mascara or apply inside the eye. Stop using it if irritation occurs.
eyeliner: ارسمي لمستكِ، من الناعم إلى الجريء.
Define your moment, softly or boldly.
Draw a light line along the lash line, building the shape in short strokes.
Use only in the areas indicated on the packaging. Do not share eye products.
eyeshadow: Start with a small amount on a suitable brush, then blend and layer gradually.
Check the available palette colours and the areas of use indicated on its packaging.
contour: Your features, with your own finishing touch.
Apply a little to the areas you want to define and blend the edges well with a suitable brush or sponge.
Choose the available shade with the store. Follow the product’s labelled areas of use.
highlighter: A small touch of light, your way.
Apply a small amount to the high points you want to highlight and blend softly.
The available shade may vary. Avoid the eye area unless the packaging specifically permits it.
blush: A touch of colour to go with your smile.
Apply a little to your cheeks and blend gradually to the intensity you prefer.
Check the available colour with the store; the photographed pack does not represent every shade.
lips: لحظة لون أو عناية، لكِ وحدكِ.
A little moment for your lips.
Apply gently to clean lips as directed on the packaging. Start with a little and add more if needed.
Choose the available colour or version. Do not share lip products, and stop use if irritation occurs.
brows: The little brow detail that finishes your look.
Use a light hand to shape or define the brows, following their natural direction.
Use only as directed, avoiding contact with the eye itself.
primer: A thoughtful start to your makeup routine.
Apply a thin layer after skincare. Allow it to settle before applying foundation.
Patch test first, especially if your skin is sensitive. Avoid the eye area.
setting-spray: A finishing moment for your makeup.
Close your eyes and mouth and mist from the distance stated on the packaging.
Do not inhale the spray. Follow the packaging directions and avoid spraying into the eyes.
bb-cc: Blend a small amount evenly over your face after your skincare routine.
Confirm the available shade. Tinted makeup does not replace a dedicated sunscreen used as directed.
nails: A little colour for your everyday mood.
Follow the exact product’s instructions on clean, dry nails. Allow each layer to dry before the next.
Gel colour may require an appropriate lamp. Check the product type before use and avoid the surrounding skin.
sunscreen: خطوة نهارية تستحق مكانًا في روتينكِ.
Make room for a daily sun-care ritual.
Apply generously and evenly as the final step of morning skincare, before sun exposure. Reapply as directed, especially after sweating or swimming.
Check the SPF and directions on your exact pack. Use shade and protective clothing as well; no sunscreen blocks all UV exposure.
cleanser: A fresh start, or a gentle end to your day.
Follow the instructions for this cleanser’s format. Massage gently without rubbing hard, and rinse or wipe off as its label directs.
Avoid contact with the eyes unless the exact product is labelled for eye makeup removal. Patch test and stop if irritation occurs.
toner: A quiet little pause between cleansing and care.
After cleansing, apply gently using your palms or a cotton pad, as directed on the pack. Follow with moisturiser.
Patch test first. If the toner contains exfoliating acids, introduce gradually and use sunscreen in the daytime.
essence: A little layer of care to look forward to.
Pat a small amount onto clean skin after toner and before moisturiser, following the pack directions.
Patch test before regular use and stop if irritation occurs.
serum: A thoughtful step in a routine that is yours.
Apply a small amount to clean skin as directed on the exact product, then follow with moisturiser. Introduce one new active product at a time.
Patch test first. Results vary by skin and routine; this product is not a substitute for medical advice.
moisturizer: Make your moisturising moment something to enjoy.
Apply a suitable amount to clean skin and massage gently. Follow the frequency and areas of use on the pack.
Patch test first. Stop use if irritation occurs and avoid contact with the eyes.
eye-care: لمسة عناية لأكثر تفاصيل وجهكِ رقة.
A small, careful moment for your eyes.
Use a very small amount in the area indicated on the pack, with gentle application and no pulling.
Keep out of the eyes. Lash products and eye creams have different directions; follow your exact product’s label.
exfoliant: Use only at the frequency and for the contact time stated on the exact packaging. Introduce gradually and follow with moisturiser.
Do not use on irritated or broken skin. Do not combine strong exfoliants in the same routine. Use daytime sunscreen and stop if irritation occurs.
face-mask: A little beauty pause, at your own pace.
Apply to clean skin for the time specified on the exact pack. Remove, rinse or leave on only as directed for that mask.
Avoid the eyes and broken skin. Patch test first; do not exceed the labelled contact time.
face-oil: A few drops to finish your care ritual.
Warm a small amount between your palms and press gently onto the areas specified on the pack.
Patch test first. Avoid the eyes, and check that the product is suitable for your skin.
mist: A little care between the moments of your day.
Close your eyes and mouth and spray gently from the distance specified on the packaging.
Avoid direct contact with the eyes and do not inhale the spray.
skincare-set: Explore your next ritual, one step at a time.
Check the directions for each item in the set and introduce new products gradually rather than all at once.
Set contents and sizes should be checked against the available pack. Patch test each new product.
shampoo: A fresh beginning for your hair ritual.
Apply to wet hair, massage the scalp gently and rinse thoroughly. Follow the packaging directions.
Avoid the eyes and stop use if scalp irritation occurs.
conditioner: الخطوة التي تجعل وقت الشعر أهدأ.
Take a little time for your lengths.
Use after shampoo as directed on the pack, paying attention to the lengths. Rinse unless the product is specifically leave-in.
Follow the exact pack instructions; rinse-out and leave-in products are used differently.
hair-mask: Give your lengths a little time of their own.
Apply as directed to the indicated areas of the hair, leave for the labelled time and rinse if required.
Do not exceed the recommended time. Avoid the eyes and check scalp-use instructions.
hair-oil: لمسة عناية قبل أن تكملي يومكِ.
A little finishing care for your hair.
Start with a few drops, apply to the areas indicated on the pack and add more only if needed.
Some oils are for lengths and others for the scalp; follow the exact product directions and patch test first.
hair-styling: Work a small amount through the specified areas and shape gently, following the exact product’s instructions.
Avoid eyes and inhaling powders or sprays. Wash out as directed.
hair-treatment: Make a little room for scalp care.
Apply only to the areas and at the frequency stated on the packaging. Massage gently if directed.
Persistent scalp problems or hair loss need professional assessment. This product does not guarantee hair growth.
body-care: Little moments of care, just for you.
Apply to the body areas indicated on the packaging and massage gently. Follow the exact product’s directions.
For external use only. Patch test and avoid irritated skin and sensitive areas unless the product is specifically labelled for them.
body-oil: A little time for yourself after your shower.
Apply a small amount to the body as directed and massage gently. Allow it to settle before dressing.
For external use. Avoid eyes and slippery surfaces; patch test first.
deodorant: An easy little step before you head out.
Apply to clean, dry underarms as directed and allow to dry before dressing.
Do not use on broken or freshly irritated skin. Stop use if irritation occurs.
body-cleansing: A fresh little ritual to call your own.
Follow the exact wash or soap directions. Cleanse gently and rinse well.
For external use. Intimate washes are external only; avoid internal use and discontinue if irritation occurs.
body-scrub: Slow down for your body-care moment.
Massage gently as directed, without hard pressure, then rinse well and moisturise.
Avoid broken or irritated skin and do not over-exfoliate.
body-sunscreen: A sun-care step before your day begins.
Apply generously to exposed body skin before sun exposure. Reapply following the exact pack directions, especially after swimming or sweating.
Check the SPF on your exact pack. Use shade and protective clothing too; no sunscreen blocks all UV exposure.
foot-care: استراحة لطيفة لقدميكِ بعد يوم طويل.
A small pause for your feet after a long day.
Use on the feet only, following the exact mask, cream or scrub directions and contact time.
Do not use on broken skin. If you have diabetes or circulation problems, ask a healthcare professional before using peeling masks or foot exfoliants.
oral-care: A little detail in your smile-care routine.
Follow the exact oral-care product’s instructions, including the recommended quantity and contact time. Do not swallow.
Cosmetic colour correction is temporary and does not replace toothbrushing or dental care. Use only as labelled.
hair-removal: A little tool for your at-home routine.
Use gently on clean skin following the tool’s exact instructions, without repeated hard pressure.
Avoid irritated skin and do not share personal grooming tools. Keep blades away from children.
foot-tools: A little care for your feet at home.
Use gently as directed without excessive pressure, then clean and dry the tool.
Do not use on broken skin. Ask a professional first if you have diabetes or circulation problems.
shapewear: Choose the correct size and adjust comfortably without restricting breathing or movement.
Not a medical product or a weight-loss treatment. Stop wearing it if it causes discomfort.
fragrance: A scent for a moment that feels like you.
Use a small amount as directed on the packaging, avoiding eyes and irritated skin.
Patch test first and check the available fragrance version with the store.
